title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 1 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The two maps below show road access to a city hospital in 2007 and in 2010.
scenario: The maps compare road access to a city hospital in 2007 and in 2010.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: City Hospital
notes: The 2007 map shows the City Hospital enclosed by Ring Road. Hospital Rd runs south from Ring Road to City Road.
In 2007, six bus stops are shown along Hospital Rd, with three on each side.
In 2007, a combined staff and public car park is east of Hospital Rd, between Ring Road and City Road.
The 2010 map shows roundabouts at the junction of Hospital Rd and Ring Road and at the junction of Hospital Rd and City Road.
In 2010, a bus station is west of Hospital Rd and is connected to both roundabouts.
In 2010, the staff car park is east of Hospital Rd and south of Ring Road.
In 2010, the public car park is east of Ring Road, with access from Ring Road.
